registry_add.plot_source: Course convention, derived: the sum over overlap lengths L of 4^-L, 33.3 % at 75 to 101 nt, from the per-length expectation Trim Galore 2.3.0 prints, src/report.rs line 638 (github.com/FelixKrueger/TrimGalore/blob/v2.3.0/src/report.rs): 'let expect = stats.total_reads as f64 / 4f64.powi(length as i32);'.
